title: KS-491: Commission a costed WAF and CAPTCHA options note, or defer both?
bluf: Ticket: there is no WAF anywhere (Cloudflare is DNS-only) and no CAPTCHA on signup, login or public verify; the Aug rows were marked 'needs Kam (product + spend), do not advance'. Other rows (rate limits, body caps, Postgres/Redis binding) were fixed and live. Peter also asks for a decision on the 'Server: nginx' header (KS-1397, LOW). No price, product choice or cost estimate is in the ticket (unverified). Only a research note is proposed; no spend and no production change without your later word.

sources.quote: No CAPTCHA/reCAPTCHA/hCaptcha/Turnstile on signup, login, or public verify

options.label: Commission a read-only costed options note for WAF and CAPTCHA; no spend, no change
options.detail: Where a WAF terminates, who runs it, price figures. Nothing deployed, nothing bought.

options.label: Defer WAF and CAPTCHA explicitly (pre-funding); record as accepted risk; no work
options.detail: Closes the ambiguity on the board. Risk stays: only IP/velocity limits stand against bots.

options.label: Approve a WAF now (spend + production edge change); product choice to follow
options.detail: Commits money and changes the live edge. Product and budget not stated in the ticket.

default_action: After 48 h nothing is bought or changed (no option chosen): the WAF/CAPTCHA rows stay open and parked, no spend.
